about.title: About Nour Medical
about.subtitle: Nour Medical Company was established in 2015 with the healthcare sector at the heart of its business.
about.storyTitle: A Healthcare Technology Company Built for the Egyptian Market
about.storyP1: Founded in 2015, Nour Medical has evolved from a healthcare equipment and radiology maintenance specialist into a broader provider of healthcare technologies and solutions. Our business covers radiology devices, medical equipment, hospital furniture, consumables, spare parts, and maintenance.
about.storyP2: The company is recognized as one of the pioneering companies in Egypt in the maintenance of imported radiology devices. We have established a trusted network of healthcare entities across the country, from hospitals in Cairo to medical centers in Upper Egypt.
about.storyP3: Through a global supplier network spanning the USA, Taiwan, and China, we provide products that emphasize durability, sustainable technologies, and high-quality service — contributing to improved healthcare standards across Egypt.
about.pillar1Desc: Long-life clinical imaging hardware engineered for 10+ years of operational durability in busy hospital environments.
about.pillar2Desc: Factory-certified biomedical engineers adhering strictly to OEM calibration procedures and safety protocols.
about.pillar3Desc: Strict radiation dose optimization, lead shielding certification, and electrical grounding verification.
about.pillar4Desc: 1,000 m² local spare parts inventory eliminating international shipping delays during critical emergency breakdowns.
about.chairmanBio: Founder and leader of Nour Medical Company since 2015, directing the company's expansion across Egypt with a focus on radiology equipment supply, specialized technical maintenance, and long-term customer partnerships.
about.directorBio: Overseeing clinical orientation, healthcare standards compliance, and client relations across Egyptian hospital networks.
about.infraDesc: Located in Maadi, Cairo, our dedicated engineering hub houses testing laboratories, calibration benches, and a comprehensive spare parts warehouse spanning over 1,000 m².
services.title: Comprehensive Lifecycle Engineering

services.partsWarehouseDesc: 1,000 m² climate-controlled depot housing critical boards, tubes, generators, and imaging coils.
